title: Audit the complete cross-platform batch workflow
description: Perform the final senior integration audit after implementation, failure coverage, CLI integration tests, and documentation/skills are complete. Verify the public contract is internally consistent across code, help, schema, README, and skills; the model-independent batch types do not leak storage snapshots into the editable format; every import requires expected updatedAt; JSON omission/null and CSV blank/_clear semantics match tests; final-state dependency validation is order-independent; no-op rows retain timestamps; all validation errors are pre-publication; prepared/committed journal recovery is safe under Unix and Windows replacement semantics; stdout is never contaminated by summaries; and canonical wtp export/legacy compatibility remain byte-contract compatible. Inspect for overlap regressions from parallel tasks and make only narrowly scoped corrections. Run targeted race/fault tests, gofmt validation, go test ./..., go vet ./..., git diff --check, ./scripts/verify.sh commit, and the PowerShell commit/smoke gate when pwsh is available. Record exact verification commands and results in the completion comment; do not redesign the accepted v1 format.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Audit started: reviewing batch contract boundaries, recovery semantics, CLI behavior, and cross-platform verification without modifying unrelated work.

comments.author: codex-wtp-loop
comments.message: Final audit passed. Narrow correction: README/help/schema now state that batch export permits at most one selector kind and exports all tasks when selectors are omitted, matching existing service/CLI/smoke behavior. Verification passed (exit 0): go test -race ./internal/batchjson ./internal/batchcsv ./internal/batchimport ./internal/batchexport ./internal/provider/flatfile ./internal/cli; go test -tags=wtp_fault_injection ./internal/provider/flatfile -count=1; go test ./internal/cli -run 'TestBatch|TestRunBatch|TestHelp|TestSchema' -count=1; gofmt -l ./cmd ./internal; go test ./...; go vet ./...; git diff --check; ./scripts/verify.sh commit; GOOS=windows GOARCH=amd64 go test -exec /usr/bin/true ./...; pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/verify.ps1 commit; pwsh -NoProfile -File ./scripts/e2e_smoke.ps1.
